      <title>Compliance Specialist (MiFID / Crypto)</title>
      <description><h4><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-e2e57587-7fff-8da0-3bca-18c1da36c351">Over Change</strong></span></h4><p><span>Change bestaat al langer dan de meeste fintechbedrijven die je kent. Opgericht in 2010 en sinds 2015 een MiFID II beleggingsonderneming. Vandaag bedienen we ongeveer 120.000 geregistreerde gebruikers in heel Europa. Ook zijn we als een van de eerste CASP's in Nederland geautoriseerd onder MiCA.</span></p><p><span>Wij exploiteren een beleggingsapp voor particulieren. Onze gebruikers handelen in cryptovaluta en in CFD's op onder andere aandelen, indices, valuta, goud en olie — allemaal op één plek.</span></p><p><span>We zijn een klein en ervaren team met een praktische cultuur. Compliance is bij ons geen sluitpost, maar een integraal onderdeel van hoe we het bedrijf bouwen. We hechten waarde aan eigenaarschap, duidelijke processen, goed beoordelingsvermogen en echte operationele discipline, in plaats van onnodige formaliteiten.</span></p><p><span>We zijn op zoek naar een <strong>hands-on Compliance Specialist</strong> die ons compliance team komt versterken en ondersteunt bij de dagelijkse compliancewerkzaamheden binnen onze MiFID- en MiCA-activiteiten.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-186b49c9-7fff-0457-88fd-5c2370264cee">Wat je gaat doen</strong></span></h5><p><br><span>Je ondersteunt de dagelijkse compliancefunctie binnen onze MiFID- en MiCA-activiteiten.</span></p><ul><li><p><span>Je ondersteunt bij de praktische implementatie van MiFID II- en IFR/IFD-vereisten in de dagelijkse bedrijfsvoering.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je helpt bij het onderhouden van AML/CFT- en transactiemonitoringprocessen.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je ondersteunt bij het vertalen van wettelijke en toezichtrechtelijke vereisten naar interne processen en procedures.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je ondersteunt bij doorlopend toezicht en de daarmee samenhangende werkzaamheden.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je ondersteunt bij compliancebeoordelingen van productwijzigingen en nieuwe functionaliteiten vóór lancering.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je helpt bij communicatie met de AFM en DNB, waaronder het voorbereiden van antwoorden op informatieverzoeken van toezichthouders.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je monitort en helpt ervoor te zorgen dat interne beleidsregels en procedures in de praktijk worden nageleefd.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je ondersteunt bij het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het compliance framework van de onderneming.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je signaleert mogelijke complianceproblemen en escaleert deze waar nodig naar de relevante senior teamleden.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je houdt relevante ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving bij en ondersteunt bij de implementatie daarvan.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je werkt nauw samen met andere teams binnen de organisatie.</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9a0067e2-7fff-8d7d-4204-b6d1d2cfaa49">Wat we zoeken</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen compliance, financiële dienstverlening, legal, risk of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Basiskennis van MiFID II en AML/CFT en de motivatie om je kennis hierin verder te ontwikkelen.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Het vermogen om wettelijke en toezichtrechtelijke vereisten te begrijpen en te helpen vertalen naar de dagelijkse praktijk.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Je bent leergierig en bereid verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor de taken die aan jou worden toevertrouwd.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.</span></p></li></ul><p><span>Het belangrijkste is dat je nieuwsgierig, proactief en gemotiveerd bent om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen compliance. Je begrijpt dat compliance niet alleen draait om wat er in beleid en procedures staat, maar vooral ook om hoe die in de praktijk worden toegepast.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-6c9b40d4-7fff-b557-266e-23b404388487">Pré</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Basiskennis van of interesse in MiCA en crypto-gerelateerde regelgeving.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Ervaring binnen fintech, crypto of een andere snel veranderende gereguleerde omgeving.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Ervaring binnen een internationale of snelgroeiende organisatie.</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-89762914-7fff-5707-eb90-d8049137f611">Wat wij bieden</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Hybride functie in Amsterdam.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Competitief salaris passend bij een snelgroeiende fintech.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Perks en benefits.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Leerbudget om je kennis verder te ontwikkelen.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Veel eigenaarschap en directe invloed.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Snelle besluitvorming, geen politiek.</span></p></li></ul><p><span>Een echte kans om op lange termijn met het bedrijf mee te groeien.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-926ab064-7fff-1d06-85d5-232bf4e03a26">Proces</strong></span></h5><p><span>Snel en overzichtelijk.</span></p><ul><li><p><span>Introductiegesprek.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Gesprek met de hiring manager.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Gesprek met senior management.</span></p></li></ul><p><span>Ben je enthousiast over compliance, financiële regelgeving en crypto — en wil je leren hoe regelgeving binnen een gereguleerde financiële onderneming daadwerkelijk in de praktijk werkt? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.</span></p></description>

      <title>Mobile QA Engineer</title>
      <description><h4>About Change</h4><p><br><span>Change has been around longer than most fintechs you've heard of. Our Dutch entity was incorporated in Amsterdam in 2010, and we have been MiFID II authorised since 2015 — a decade of operating as a regulated investment firm. Today we serve around 120,000 verified users across all 30 EEA countries, with full passporting rights, and we are MiCA-authorised as one of the early CASPs in the Netherlands.</span></p><p><span>We operate an app-based investment platform built for retail investors. Our users trade cryptocurrencies, alongside CFDs on stocks, indices, currencies, gold, oil and other financial instruments — all in one place, on mobile, with the regulatory protections of a Dutch investment firm.</span></p><p><span>We are a small senior team with a practical, low-bureaucracy culture. We value ownership, clear processes, strong judgement and real operational discipline over unnecessary ceremony.</span></p><p><span>When a user funds an account, places an order or moves crypto, it has to work — every time, on every device. We are hiring a Mobile QA Engineer to own quality for our Flutter app across iOS and Android, and to treat AI agents and tooling as a core part of how modern QA gets done.</span></p><h5><br><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-4288bafc-7fff-f6fa-f476-937e9ecd3898">What you will do</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span><strong>Own quality for the mobile app.</strong> Manual and automated testing across iOS and Android, from onboarding and KYC to funding, trading and custody flows.</span></p></li><li><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-4f3bf3e2-7fff-1cf4-e51c-9b5fde3991a1">Build and grow our mobile test automation. </strong>Design and maintain an automated suite (integration_test, Appium, Maestro or similar) that gives the team confidence to ship fast without breaking money-moving flows.</span></p></li><li><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-d1b716c0-7fff-9ba3-7496-355cf90dd9e5">Test the flows that matter most. </strong>Order tickets, charts, portfolio, deposits and withdrawals — with a sharp eye for edge cases, error states and the things that only break under real market conditions.</span></p></li><li><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-52efcea1-7fff-3636-792e-d2262152fd86">Own release quality. </strong>Regression passes, device/OS coverage, staged rollouts, crash triage and being the last line of defence before an update reaches 120,000 users.</span></p></li><li><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-781ba818-7fff-934c-930b-6633bd8882ac">Make quality measurable. </strong>Clear test plans, bug reports engineers can act on, and metrics that show where quality is improving and where it is not.</span></p></li><li><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-dd0bea19-7fff-ee09-a063-ea168cff6780">Use AI agents to scale QA. </strong>Generate test cases, triage crash logs and expand coverage with agentic tooling — while keeping human judgement where it counts in a regulated product.</span><br></p></li></ul><h5>Who we're looking for<br><br><span><strong>QA depth</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>3+ years<strong id="docs-internal-guid-47fd4fd1-7fff-d3ca-f7ac-18661f799725"> </strong>in QA, with real experience testing mobile apps on both iOS and Android.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Hands-on test automation experience — Flutter integration_test, Appium, Maestro, or equivalent mobile automation frameworks.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong test design instincts: you think in edge cases, boundary conditions, error states and "what happens if things go wrong".</span></p></li><li><p><span>Comfortable reading API responses, inspecting logs, and writing clear, reproducible bug reports that engineers respect.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Understanding of CI/CD and how automated tests fit into a fast, frequent release cadence.</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong>AI-native, agentic-first</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>You use AI tools and coding agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor or similar) regularly as part of your QA workflow.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You have built or customised at least one practical AI-assisted testing or automation workflow.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You have clear judgement on where humans must stay in the loop in a regulated, money-moving product. You are not impressed by demos.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You understand that strong AI outputs depend on good context, structure and human judgement.</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong>Mindset</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>You communicate in writing well enough that meetings shrink — crisp test plans, clear bug reports, honest release notes.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You enjoy the boring craft of quality: the regression pass, the flaky-test hunt, the edge case nobody else thought of. You do not consider this work beneath you.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You are visibly comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong". You change your mind when the evidence changes.</span></p></li><li><p><span>You want to grow your scope and impact here over time. We will invest in that growth as the team scales.</span></p></li></ul><h5>Nice to have</h5><ul><li><p><span>Experience in fintech, trading, payments or another trust-critical consumer product.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Familiarity with MiFID II, MiCA, PSD2 or similarly regulated environments.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Experience testing trading surfaces — order tickets, charts, watchlists, order books and portfolio screens.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Performance, security or accessibility testing experience.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Greek or Dutch language is welcome but not required — we work in English.</span></p></li></ul><h5>What we offer</h5><ul><li><p><span>Hybrid role (Amsterdam)</span></p></li><li><p><span>Travel to Athens and Estonia a few times a year</span></p></li><li><p><span>Competitive base salary</span></p></li><li><p><span>Perks and benefits</span></p></li><li><p><span>Learning budget to keep you sharp</span></p></li><li><p><span>Real ownership and influence</span></p></li><li><p><span>Fast decisions, zero politics</span></p></li><li><p><span>A real shot at growing with the company long-term</span></p></li></ul><h5>Process</h5><ul><li><p><span>Fast-moving and straightforward</span></p></li><li><p><span>Intro call</span></p></li><li><p><span>Hiring manager interview</span></p></li><li><p><span>Take-home assignment or live exercise</span></p></li><li><p><span>Conversation with senior management</span></p></li></ul><p><span>This role is demanding but also rewarding. If you want to build, take ownership, and grow with a startup, we'd love to talk. Apply now.</span></p><p><br></p></description>

    <item>
      <title>Senior Engineer</title>
      <description><h4>About Change</h4><p><span>Change has been around longer than most fintechs you've heard of. Our Dutch entity was incorporated in Amsterdam in 2010, and we have been MiFID II authorised since 2015, a decade of operating as a regulated investment firm. Today we serve around 120,000 verified users across all 30 EEA countries, with full passporting rights, and we are MiCA-authorised as one of the early CASPs in the Netherlands.</span></p><p><span><br>We operate an app-based investment platform built for retail investors. Our users trade cryptocurrencies, alongside CFDs on stocks, indices, currencies, gold, oil and other financial instruments — all in one place, on mobile, with the regulatory protections of a Dutch investment firm.</span></p><p><span>We are a small senior team with a practical, low-bureaucracy culture. We value ownership, clear processes, strong judgement and real operational discipline over unnecessary ceremony.</span></p><p><span>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Engineer </strong>who treats AI agents and tooling as a core part of the SDLC — building, shipping and operating systems with tools like Codex, Claude Code and automated reviewers as standard engineering practice.</span></p><h5>What you will do</h5><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Take ownership of one or two core domains end-to-end, execution, custody integration, market data, risk, or the trading core, and ship measurable improvements against real, regulated, money-moving systems.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Contribute meaningfully to the Kotlin-vs-.NET architectural evaluation: prototype, benchmark, document, push back. Help us produce an honest decision rather than a fashionable one.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Define and prove out our agentic SDLC: how we use coding agents in design, in review, in testing, in incident response. Make the patterns explicit so the rest of the team can copy them.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Raise the engineering bar by example; clean, well-tested, observable code that other engineers want to read and extend. Become the person whose PRs others learn from.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Partner closely with the Dutch business hub, our compliance and marketing functions, and our infrastructure team. Speed and regulatory standing are not in tension here; we expect you to deliver both.</span></p><h5>Who we are looking for</h5><p><strong>Engineering depth</strong></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• </span>5+ years building production systems where correctness and uptime matter, ideally in finance, payments, trading or similarly demanding environments.</p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• </span>Strong expertise in either the modern JVM ecosystem (Kotlin, Spring Boot, Kafka) or modern .NET (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core), with openness to work across both.</p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• </span>Comfortable with AWS, EKS, observability and infrastructure concepts;       <title>Senior Engineer</title>
      <description><h4>About Change</h4><p><span>Change has been around longer than most fintechs you've heard of. Our Dutch entity was incorporated in Amsterdam in 2010, and we have been MiFID II authorised since 2015, a decade of operating as a regulated investment firm. Today we serve around 120,000 verified users across all 30 EEA countries, with full passporting rights, and we are MiCA-authorised as one of the early CASPs in the Netherlands.</span></p><p><span><br>We operate an app-based investment platform built for retail investors. Our users trade cryptocurrencies, alongside CFDs on stocks, indices, currencies, gold, oil and other financial instruments — all in one place, on mobile, with the regulatory protections of a Dutch investment firm.</span></p><p><span>We are a small senior team with a practical, low-bureaucracy culture. We value ownership, clear processes, strong judgement and real operational discipline over unnecessary ceremony.</span></p><p><span>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Engineer </strong>who treats AI agents and tooling as a core part of the SDLC — building, shipping and operating systems with tools like Codex, Claude Code and automated reviewers as standard engineering practice.</span></p><h5>What you will do</h5><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Take ownership of one or two core domains end-to-end, execution, custody integration, market data, risk, or the trading core, and ship measurable improvements against real, regulated, money-moving systems.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span>• Contribute meaningfully to the Kotlin-vs-.NET architectural evaluation: prototype, benchmark, document, push back.
